Cisco IOS 15.2M&T - Retirement Notification

The Cisco IOS 15.2M&T has been retired and is no longer supported.

  • End-of-Sale Date: 2015-01-27

  • End-of-Support Date: 2020-01-31

  • Cisco's End-of-Life Policy

You can view a listing of available Networking Software (IOS & NX-OS) offerings that best meet your specific needs
